statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite medical management
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The service is to detect intermittent arrhythmias associated with the patient's documented symptoms (R42)
The denial reason code is PR-204
